items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Did he play snare drum or? Snare drum. Uh-huh. That was with Manuel Perez. Right. Is that what they called the Onward Band or do you remember? Yeah, I think it was.

ctx.x: And I used to like to see him, I used to follow him all the time.
Did he play snare drum or? Snare drum. Uh-huh. That was with Manuel Perez. Right. Is that what they called the Onward Band or do you remember?
Yeah, I think it was. I was quite small. You know.
